title: Rook Ceph CRD Resources
description: Schema for Rook Ceph Custom Resource Definitions used to declaratively manage Ceph storage clusters on Kubernetes. Covers CephCluster, CephBlockPool, CephFilesystem, CephObjectStore, CephObjectStoreUser, and related storage primitives.

ObjectMeta.title: ObjectMeta
ObjectMeta.description: Kubernetes object metadata common to all CRD resources

name.description: Name of the Kubernetes resource, unique within its namespace

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace where the resource is deployed

labels.description: Key-value labels for organizing and selecting Kubernetes resources

annotations.description: Key-value annotations for storing non-identifying metadata

ResourceRequirements.title: ResourceRequirements
ResourceRequirements.description: Kubernetes CPU and memory resource requests and limits for Ceph daemon pods

requests.description: Minimum resource amounts requested from the Kubernetes scheduler

cpu.description: CPU request (e.g., '500m' for half a core or '2' for 2 cores)

limits.description: Maximum resource amounts the container may consume

Placement.title: Placement
Placement.description: Kubernetes scheduling constraints for placing Ceph daemon pods on specific nodes

nodeAffinity.description: Node affinity rules for restricting which nodes daemons can run on

podAffinity.description: Pod affinity rules for co-locating daemons with other pods

podAntiAffinity.description: Pod anti-affinity rules for spreading daemons across nodes or zones

tolerations.description: Tolerations allowing daemon pods to be scheduled on tainted nodes

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Constraints for spreading daemon pods across topology domains

NetworkSpec.title: NetworkSpec
NetworkSpec.description: Network configuration for the Ceph cluster including host networking and provider settings

provider.description: Network provider to use for Ceph cluster networking

selectors.description: Network interface selectors when using Multus CNI

hostNetwork.description: When true, Ceph daemons use the host network namespace instead of pod networking

ipFamily.description: IP address family for Ceph cluster networking

dualStack.description: When true, enables dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 networking for the Ceph cluster

CephClusterSpec.title: CephClusterSpec
CephClusterSpec.description: Specification for a CephCluster resource defining the desired state of a Ceph storage cluster managed by Rook

allowUnsupported.description: When true, allows running unsupported Ceph versions

dataDirHostPath.description: Host path on each node where Ceph configuration and data will be stored (e.g., '/var/lib/rook')

skipUpgradeChecks.description: When true, skips safety checks before upgrading the Ceph version

continueUpgradeAfterChecksEvenIfNotHealt.description: When true, continues cluster upgrades even if the cluster is not fully healthy

waitTimeoutForHealthyOSDInMinutes.description: Timeout in minutes to wait for OSDs to become healthy before aborting an upgrade

mon.description: Configuration for Ceph Monitor (MON) daemons that maintain cluster state

count.description: Number of MON daemons to run. Should be an odd number for quorum (typically 3 or 5).

allowMultiplePerNode.description: When true, allows multiple MON pods to run on the same node (not recommended for production)

volumeClaimTemplate.description: PVC template for MON data storage when using PVCs instead of host paths

mgr.description: Configuration for Ceph Manager (MGR) daemons that provide monitoring and management services

count.description: Number of MGR daemons to run (typically 1 or 2)

allowMultiplePerNode.description: When true, allows multiple MGR pods to run on the same node

modules.description: Ceph MGR modules to enable (e.g., pg_autoscaler, prometheus)

name.description: Name of the MGR module to enable or disable

enabled.description: Whether this module should be enabled

dashboard.description: Configuration for the Ceph Dashboard web UI

enabled.description: Whether to enable the Ceph Dashboard

urlPrefix.description: URL prefix for the dashboard when served behind a reverse proxy

port.description: Port number for the Ceph Dashboard

ssl.description: When true, enables SSL/TLS for the Ceph Dashboard

enabled.description: When true, creates a ServiceMonitor for Prometheus to scrape Ceph metrics

network.description: Network configuration for the Ceph cluster

storage.description: Storage configuration specifying which nodes and devices to use for Ceph OSDs

useAllNodes.description: When true, uses all available nodes for Ceph OSDs

useAllDevices.description: When true, uses all available block devices on selected nodes for OSDs

deviceFilter.description: Regular expression to match device names to include as OSDs

nodes.description: Explicit list of nodes and devices to use for Ceph OSDs

storageClassDeviceSets.description: PVC-based OSD configuration using StorageClass device sets

placement.description: Placement configuration per daemon type (all, mon, osd, mgr, mds, rgw)

resources.description: Resource requests and limits per daemon type

priorityClassNames.description: Kubernetes PriorityClass names assigned per daemon type

labels.description: Labels to apply to daemon pods per daemon type

annotations.description: Annotations to apply to daemon pods per daemon type

crashCollector.description: Configuration for the Ceph crash collector daemon

disable.description: When true, disables the crash collector daemon

daysToRetain.description: Number of days to retain crash reports before deletion

logCollector.description: Configuration for collecting Ceph daemon logs

enabled.description: When true, enables the log collector sidecar for Ceph daemons

maxLogSize.description: Maximum log file size before rotation (e.g., '500M')

cleanupPolicy.description: Policy for cleaning up cluster data when the CephCluster is deleted

confirmation.description: Confirmation string required to enable data deletion ('yes-really-destroy-data')

sanitizeDisks.description: Configuration for sanitizing (wiping) OSD disks on cleanup

allowUninstallWithVolumes.description: When true, allows cluster deletion even if PVCs are still present

Node.title: Node
Node.description: A Kubernetes node configuration specifying which devices to use for Ceph OSDs

name.description: Hostname or node name in the Kubernetes cluster

devices.description: List of specific block devices on this node to use as Ceph OSDs

deviceFilter.description: Regular expression to match device names on this specific node

useAllDevices.description: When true, uses all available devices on this node

StorageClassDeviceSet.title: StorageClassDeviceSet
StorageClassDeviceSet.description: A PVC-based OSD device set that provisions OSDs using a Kubernetes StorageClass

name.description: Name of the device set for identification

count.description: Number of OSDs to provision in this device set

replica.description: Number of replicas per OSD (for erasure coding configurations)

portable.description: When true, OSD pods can be rescheduled to different nodes

tuneSlowDeviceClass.description: When true, applies OSD settings optimized for slow devices (HDDs)

tuneFastDeviceClass.description: When true, applies OSD settings optimized for fast devices (NVMe SSDs)

volumeClaimTemplates.description: PVC templates defining the storage volumes to provision for each OSD

items.description: A PVC template for OSD storage

CephBlockPoolSpec.title: CephBlockPoolSpec
CephBlockPoolSpec.description: Specification for a CephBlockPool resource defining a Ceph RADOS Block Device (RBD) pool for block storage

failureDomain.description: CRUSH failure domain for data distribution (e.g., 'host', 'rack', 'zone')

crushRoot.description: CRUSH root for this pool overriding the default CRUSH hierarchy root

deviceClass.description: Ceph device class for this pool (e.g., 'hdd', 'ssd', 'nvme')

replicated.description: Replicated pool configuration (use instead of erasureCoded)

size.description: Number of replicas for data in this pool

requireSafeReplicaSize.description: When true, requires the replica size to guarantee data safety

replicasPerFailureDomain.description: Number of replicas per failure domain for stretched clusters

erasureCoded.description: Erasure coded pool configuration (use instead of replicated)

dataChunks.description: Number of data chunks for erasure coding

codingChunks.description: Number of coding (parity) chunks for erasure coding

parameters.description: Additional Ceph pool parameters as key-value pairs

mirroring.description: RBD mirroring configuration for cross-cluster replication

enabled.description: When true, enables RBD mirroring for this block pool

quotas.description: Storage quota limits for this pool

maxBytes.description: Maximum total bytes for this pool (e.g., '10Gi')

maxObjects.description: Maximum number of objects in this pool

CephFilesystemSpec.title: CephFilesystemSpec
CephFilesystemSpec.description: Specification for a CephFilesystem resource defining a CephFS shared filesystem with metadata and data pools

metadataPool.description: Configuration for the CephFS metadata pool storing filesystem metadata

replicated.description: Replication configuration for the metadata pool

failureDomain.description: CRUSH failure domain for metadata pool

dataPools.description: List of data pool configurations for storing filesystem file data

preserveFilesystemOnDelete.description: When true, preserves the Ceph filesystem when the CephFilesystem CRD is deleted

metadataServer.description: Configuration for Ceph Metadata Server (MDS) daemons

activeCount.description: Number of active MDS daemons to run

activeStandby.description: When true, provisions standby MDS daemons for each active one

CephObjectStoreSpec.title: CephObjectStoreSpec
CephObjectStoreSpec.description: Specification for a CephObjectStore resource deploying a Ceph RADOS Gateway (RGW) providing S3 and Swift compatible object storage

metadataPool.description: Configuration for the object store metadata pools

dataPool.description: Configuration for the object store data pool

preservePoolsOnDelete.description: When true, preserves Ceph pools when the CephObjectStore CRD is deleted

gateway.description: Configuration for the Ceph RADOS Gateway (RGW) HTTP/S3 service

sslCertificateRef.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret containing the TLS certificate for HTTPS

port.description: HTTP port for the RGW service

securePort.description: HTTPS port for the RGW service

instances.description: Number of RGW daemon instances to run

zone.description: RGW zone configuration for multi-site object storage

name.description: Name of the Ceph zone for this object store

CephObjectStoreUserSpec.title: CephObjectStoreUserSpec
CephObjectStoreUserSpec.description: Specification for a CephObjectStoreUser resource creating an RGW user with S3 credentials

store.description: Name of the CephObjectStore this user belongs to

displayName.description: Human-readable display name for the object store user

capabilities.description: Ceph RGW administrative capabilities granted to this user

maxBuckets.description: Maximum number of buckets this user can create

maxSize.description: Maximum total storage size for this user (e.g., '10Gi')

maxObjects.description: Maximum number of objects this user can store
